mapper.sql: WITH latest_match AS ( SELECT ppm.PRODUCT_NO, ppm.COMPARED_PRICE, ps.AVG_PRICE, ppm.SAVING_RATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ppm.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE DESC, ps.SNAPSHOT_NO DESC ) AS rn FROM OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_MATCH ppm JOIN OFT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT ps ON ps.SNAPSHOT_NO = ppm.SNAPSHOT_NO )
mapper.select: SELECT CART_NO FROM OFT_CART WHERE USER_NO = #{_parameter} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT cg.CART_GROUP_NO AS cartGroupNo, cg.CART_NO AS cartNo, cg.GROUP_KEY AS groupKey, cg.GROUP_TYPE AS groupType, cg.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, cg.GROUP_NAME AS groupName, cg.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, cg.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_CART c JOIN OFT_CART_GROUP cg ON cg.CART_NO = c.CART_NO WHERE c.USER_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY cg.CREATED_AT ASC, cg.CART_GROUP_NO ASC

SELECT ci.CART_ITEM_NO AS cartItemNo, ci.CART_NO AS cartNo, ci.CART_GROUP_NO AS cartGroupNo, ci.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.ORIGIN AS origin, p.UNIT AS unit, p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT AS packageWeight, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, NVL(lm.COMPARED_PRICE, lm.AVG_PRICE) AS avgPrice, lm.SAVING_RATE AS savingRate, GREATEST(NVL(lm.COMPARED_PRICE, NVL(lm.AVG_PRICE, 0)) - p.SALE_PRICE, 0) * ci.QUANTITY AS savedAmount, img.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo, ci.QUANTITY AS quantity, ci.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, ci.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_CART c JOIN OFT_CART_GROUP cg ON cg.CART_NO = c.CART_NO JOIN OFT_CART_ITEM ci ON ci.CART_GROUP_NO = cg.CART_GROUP_NO JOIN OFT_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_NO = ci.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN latest_match lm ON lm.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO AND lm.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MIN(IMAGE_NO) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(SORT_ORDER, 99999), IMAGE_NO ) AS IMAGE_NO FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) img ON img.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE c.USER_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY cg.CREATED_AT ASC, cg.CART_GROUP_NO ASC, ci.CREATED_AT ASC, ci.CART_ITEM_NO ASC

SELECT CART_GROUP_NO AS cartGroupNo, CART_NO AS cartNo, GROUP_KEY AS groupKey, GROUP_TYPE AS groupType, RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, GROUP_NAME AS groupName, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_CART_GROUP WHERE CART_NO = #{cartNo} AND GROUP_KEY = #{groupKey} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CART_ITEM_NO AS cartItemNo, CART_NO AS cartNo, CART_GROUP_NO AS cartGroupNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, QUANTITY AS quantity, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_CART_ITEM WHERE CART_GROUP_NO = #{cartGroupNo} AND PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ci.CART_ITEM_NO AS cartItemNo, ci.CART_NO AS cartNo, ci.CART_GROUP_NO AS cartGroupNo, ci.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, ci.QUANTITY AS quantity, ci.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, ci.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_CART c JOIN OFT_CART_ITEM ci ON ci.CART_NO = c.CART_NO WHERE c.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND ci.CART_ITEM_NO = #{cartItemNo} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_CART_GROUP ( CART_NO, GROUP_KEY, GROUP_TYPE, RECIPE_NO, GROUP_NAME ) VALUES ( #{cartNo}, #{groupKey}, #{groupType}, #{recipeNo}, #{groupName} )
INSERT INTO OFT_CART_ITEM ( CART_NO, CART_GROUP_NO, PRODUCT_NO, QUANTITY ) VALUES ( #{cartNo}, #{cartGroupNo}, #{productNo}, #{quantity} )
